content:
frank: quick thread to debate price-aware backpressure + tenant cohorting. i'm worried current shedder treats every request equally and we lose cost signals. need proposal for adding price into admission and fairness.

anya: agree. naive idea: multiply tokens by model_price before comparing to quota. but that can create oscillation when prices update. we need smoothing and clear interface boundaries.

kevin: two design axes: 1) weight model_cost into the fairness allocator (controller). 2) surface cheap_hint header so proxies can make fast local decisions. both require signed weight snapshots to avoid spoof.

sophia: can we do cohorting? group tenants by price-sensitivity or billing tier so we preserve fairness within cohort and allow different degradation strategies across cohorts (e.g., older customers get softer shed).

frank: cohorting + price-aware allocator sketch: controller computes per-tenant effective_weight = base_weight * price_multiplier * cohort_multiplier. controller publishes weight snapshots with epoch id. proxies apply smoothed weights.

kevin: price_multiplier = avg_token_price / baseline_price. that biases allocator to favor cheaper requests when capacity is constrained. but billing team warned this implicitly penalizes high-value models that customers paid for. need explicit opt-in or billing visibility.

anya: opt-in via tenant flag makes sense. also add a safety cap so price_multiplier in [0.5, 2.0] default. and allow tenant override policy: prioritize-preserve-cost or prioritize-preserve-requests.

frank: proxy-level fast-path pseudo:
```yaml
on_request(req):
  weight = lookup_smoothed_weight(req.tenant)
  adjusted_budget = global_budget_for_proxy * weight
  if token_cost_estimate * current_rate <= adjusted_budget * (1 + burst_tolerance): admit
  else if fallback_config.allow_reservation: call_reservation()
  else: reject(429, reason=quota_shed)
```

kevin: token_cost_estimate can come from header hint or from inline model id lookup. trust model id more than client hint. add hint_trust decay if mismatches.

sophia: security & audit: snapshots must be signed JWS with epoch. proxies should expose weight_epoch in metrics. add signature_failure_rate alert.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "price-aware-allocator" enabled in canary cluster alpha-2

anya: telemetry plan (promql-ish):
- cohort_fairness = stddev_over_time(sum(rate(tokens[5m])) by (tenant_cohort)[30m:]) / avg_over_time(sum(rate(tokens[5m])) by (tenant_cohort)[30m:])
- price_bias_ratio = sum(rate(tokens*token_price[5m])) by (cohort) / sum(rate(tokens[5m])) by (cohort)
- reservation_fail_rate = increase(reservation_denied_total[5m]) / increase(reservation_request_total[5m])

frank: rollout gates: 1) weight snapshots v1 published to kafka (read-only) 2) proxies consume snapshots and log weight_epoch but don't enforce 3) enable enforcement for internal cohorts only 4) expand to opted-in tenants 5) enable globally if metrics stable.

kevin: bench plan: multi-region test with 20k tenants, 8% opted-in, mix of cheap and expensive models. metrics: p99 latency, cohort_fairness, billing_assignment_error. schedule bench next Wed.

sophia: billing assignment: when allocator favors cheap traffic, we must ensure usage is still billed correctly. controller should emit allocation_events with (tenant, tokens, applied_epoch, price_multiplier). these go to billing pipeline. need schema change.

anya: abuse angle: malicious tenants could set model_id to low-price model to game weighting. proxy must validate model id usage vs observed token size and raise hint_trust score if mismatch. repeated mismatch => mark tenant as suspect and remove price-based privileges.

frank: corner-case: price spikes (model repricing) could instantly change multipliers. plan: epoched snapshots and smooth multipliers over 60s with exponential decay. also apply a max_delta_limit per-epoch to avoid hard jumps.

kevin: ops knobs: smoothing_alpha, max_delta_per_minute, cohort_weights, opt_in_flag. expose them in console under "Admission tuning".

sophia: metrics to alert ops: sudden_cohort_shift = change_in_cohort_share > 0.15 in 5m, signature_mismatch_rate > 0.01, price_bias_ratio deviates from expected by > 30%.

ops-bot: ticket created INFRA-5033 "price-aware backpressure playbook" assigned to @frank

frank: follow-ups: i'll draft a short RFC addendum: weight snapshot schema, proxy admission pseudocode, bench plan, metric dashboards, billing event schema. please react with :thumbsup: if no blockers.

anya: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:
